-- name: ListCategoryFilterOptions
SELECT
    0 AS id,
    'Any category' AS name,
    NULL AS slug,
    1 AS sort_group
UNION ALL
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.slug,
    2
FROM categories c
WHERE
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM products p
        WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.discontinued_on IS NULL
    )
ORDER BY sort_group, name;
